channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: Romanian arbitrator joins Eversheds
item.description: Luminita Popa has joined Eversheds Sutherland as a partner in Bucharest, a year and a half after leaving Romanian firm Suciu Popa to launch an independent arbitrator practice.

item.title: Samsung brings new ICC claim in billion-dollar royalties dispute
item.description: South Korea’s Samsung has filed a new ICC claim against InterDigital after a tribunal determined that the US tech developer should receive US$1.05 billion in royalties under a renewed patent licence for its cellular wireless and video technologies.

item.title: Electricity investors launch tax claim against Peru
item.description: US investors have brought a US$60 million ICSID claim against Peru over a tax on the sale of an electricity distribution business.

item.title: Panama port dispute escalates with treaty notice
item.description: Hong Kong-based conglomerate CK Hutchison Holdings has threatened Panama with an investment treaty claim over alleged efforts to strip it of a port concession – days after filing an ICC claim.

item.title: Guatemala fails to stay enforcement of highways award
item.description: A US court has rejected Guatemala’s bid to stay enforcement of a road construction company’s US$37.4 million award on sovereign immunity grounds, two months after rejecting similar arguments in relation to three other awards won by the award creditor.

item.title: LatAm boutique promotes pair
item.description: GAR 100 Latin American disputes boutique Adell & Merizalde has promoted Francisco Batlle in Santo Domingo and Nicolás Córdoba in Bogota to the partnership.

item.title: Rusal affiliate’s sanctions defence fails on appeal in Jersey
item.description: The Jersey Court of Appeal has upheld the enforcement of a €214 million LCIA award against a subsidiary of Russian aluminium group Rusal, rejecting arguments that payment would breach the island’s sanctions law.

item.title: Syria's potential highlighted in Riyadh
item.description: In a much-anticipated interview at the SCCA conference in Riyadh, French-Syrian arbitrator Georges Affaki and Syrian minister of the economy Nidal-Al Shaar discussed the potential for investment in the country 15 months after the fall of the Assad regime and the role of arbitration in encouraging investment and supporting the rule of law.

item.title: “This could break anyone”: Gharavi opens up about Jordan Chiles case
item.description: In an exclusive interview, Hamid Gharavi tells GAR about his experience of arbitrating the Jordan Chiles case at the Paris Olympics for the Court of Arbitration for Sport, the "defamatory and unfair" article published about him in The Washington Post and what it was like to be at the centre of a media storm.

item.title: Sands disqualified from Turkmen oil case over parallel appointment
item.description: Philippe Sands KC has been disqualified from hearing a Cypriot-owned oil company’s ICSID claim against Turkmenistan due to his appointment in a previously unreported parallel case – as Honduras fails to remove the entire tribunal from a separate case over a highway contract.
